frase_gancho.texto: A museum that begins before the first hall.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: Before you cross a single doorway, you are already inside the story. This building, which Pedro Ramírez Vázquez and his team raised in barely nineteen months and which opened on September 17, 1964, was conceived to tell the same story as the halls. Out here, waiting for you, are a stone god who crossed the city, a facade that looks toward Uxmal, a bronze umbrella that turns water into a waterfall, a pond that recalls the lake, and a mural with two animals that explain how the ancient Mexicans understood the world. Walk slowly, look up, and when you are ready, step inside: the first hall awaits you on the other side of the vestibule.
